# Telzon Academy — Digital Marketing Institute & Agency, Nagpur

> Telzon Academy is a digital marketing training institute and agency based in Nagpur, India. We train students, working professionals and business owners in SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media marketing, content marketing and analytics through practical, project-based courses. We also offer full-service digital marketing for Nagpur businesses.
